shipping.source: Shopify Shipping label costs from ShopifyQL (FROM shipping_labels)

notes.shopify_plan_monthly: Grow plan list price on monthly billing ($79/mo if billed annually). Edit to match your Shopify invoice.
notes.shopify_apps_monthly: Recurring app charges from Settings > Billing. Not exposed by the Admin API, so enter manually.
notes.exclude_channels: Sales, units, product cost, shipping labels and payments from these Shopify sales channels are left out of every figure.
notes.payers: Company that pays each cost, and (payouts) the company that receives Shopify revenue. A list of {from, payer} changes the payer by date (each entry runs until the next starts). null means not assigned yet.
notes.ad_managers: Who ran the Meta ad account, by start date. Each period runs until the next one starts.

cogs.note: Landed cost per unit (product + freight to USA) from the Roofus master sheet (data/product_costs.csv), matched to Shopify product titles (regex, first match wins). Bundles carry their full cost, gifts included: Buy 1 Get 1 = 2 canisters ($2.52); Buy 2 Get 2 = 4 canisters + poop bags ($5.04 + $1.19); Buy 3 Get 3 = 6 canisters + poop bags + paw cleanser ($7.56 + $1.19 + $0.82). Gift line items are $0 so they aren't counted twice.

rules.label: Buy 3 Get 3: 6 canisters + poop bags + paw cleanser
Ear Buy 2 Get 2: 4 x ROO-EAR-FF-100 + poop bags

settlement.note: Profit and loss is shared 50/50. The amount owed brings each company's net (received minus paid) to its share of the combined result.
